disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 核查凭据面：/provider 交互向导把用户输入的 API Key 通过宿主凭据接口写入 ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml（0600，界面只显示掩码），channel.ts 中的两处凭据写入调用均属于该向导；未发现任何直接读取 ~/.ssh、~/.aws、id_rsa 等敏感路径的代码路径，也未发现把凭据内容发往网络的链条。
checked_items.en: Credential surface check: the /provider interactive wizard writes the user-entered API Key to ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml (0600, UI shows only masked) via the host credential interface; the two credential-writing calls in channel.ts both belong to this wizard; no code path directly reads sensitive paths such as ~/.ssh, ~/.aws, id_rsa, and no chain that sends credential content to the network was found.

checked_items.zh: 预扫命中的凭据路径引用（规则编号 DG-R1-51）逐条核对：均为文档说明、界面文案与开发脚本（测试脚本写入临时测试凭据后断言权限），无一构成读取加外发的组合，裁决为良性。
checked_items.en: The credential-path references hit by the prescan (rule ID DG-R1-51) were checked one by one: they are all documentation, UI copy, and development scripts (a test script writes temporary test credentials and then asserts permissions); none forms a read-plus-exfiltration combination, ruling as benign.

evidence.zh: 凭据面仅为 /provider 向导经宿主接口写入用户输入的 API Key（0600），无代码路径直接读取 .credentials.yaml、~/.ssh 等敏感文件并外发；src 中唯一网络调用（/update 查询 npm registry）不携带任何凭据。
evidence.en: The credential surface is limited to the /provider wizard writing user-entered API Keys (0600) via the host interface; no code path directly reads and exfiltrates sensitive files such as .credentials.yaml or ~/.ssh; the only network call in src (/update querying the npm registry) carries no credentials.

checked_items.zh: 审查了会进入模型上下文的所有工具描述：liangshen 预设注册的 bash（含 Windows 无沙箱的如实说明）、skill_search、skill_load 等均为正常功能说明，无覆写指令、无诱导读取凭据、无诱导安装或改权限的措辞。
checked_items.en: All tool descriptions that enter the model context were reviewed: the bash registered by the liangshen preset (including an honest note about no sandbox on Windows), skill_search, skill_load, etc. are all normal functional descriptions; no instruction-overriding wording, no induced credential reading, no induced installs or permission changes.

checked_items.zh: 技能目录 7 个 SKILL.md（audit、bug、pr-comments、practice、release-notes、review、vuln-check）为开发辅助技能的步骤说明，无隐藏指令、无远程指令加载。
checked_items.en: The 7 SKILL.md files in the skills directory (audit, bug, pr-comments, practice, release-notes, review, vuln-check) are step-by-step instructions for development-assist skills; no hidden instructions, no remote instruction loading.

checked_items.zh: 预设 instruction-hint 会在会话首次工具调用后注入一条提示，告知模型工作区存在 AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md 并按需阅读（不注入文件内容），属上下文管理设计而非恶意注入；工具名与官方工具撞名的 bash 重注册为 Windows 兼容的既定替换，描述如实披露差异。
checked_items.en: The preset instruction-hint injects a hint after the first tool call of a session, informing the model that AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md exist in the workspace and to read them as needed (it does not inject file contents); this is a context-management design, not malicious injection; the bash re-registration, whose name collides with the official tool name, is an established replacement for Windows compatibility, and the description honestly discloses the difference.

evidence.zh: 对注册给模型的工具描述与预设注入提示逐条语义审查，均为功能说明或上下文管理提示，无系统指令覆写、无越权指令、无隐藏意图；README 与文档无诱导性指令文本。
evidence.en: A semantic review was performed item by item on the tool descriptions registered to the model and the preset injected hints; they are all functional descriptions or context-management hints, with no system-instruction override, no privilege-escalation instruction, and no hidden intent; the README and docs contain no inducing instruction text.

evidence.zh: 工具描述与文档不含诱导模型执行安装、改写配置或放开权限的措辞；安装指引（install.sh、README）为面向用户的 CLI 命令说明，非注入模型的行为指令。
evidence.en: The tool descriptions and documentation contain no wording that induces the model to execute installs, rewrite configuration, or loosen permissions; the install guidance (install.sh, README) is user-facing CLI command documentation, not behavioral instructions injected into the model.

checked_items.zh: patch 配置（cordis.patch.yml、cordis.yml）中的动态 JS 表达式（规则编号 DG-R3-51）共约 40 处逐一人工精读：全部为环境变量读取（DSH_TUI_*、DEEPSEEK_BASE_URL 等）、平台判断、路径计算与行去重判断，无远程加载、无文件写入、无凭据访问等恶意载荷；该面在宿主进程求值时求值的是本插件自己的声明配置。
checked_items.en: The dynamic JS expressions in the patch configuration (cordis.patch.yml, cordis.yml) (rule ID DG-R3-51) total about 40 and were each manually read closely: all are environment-variable reads (DSH_TUI_*, DEEPSEEK_BASE_URL, etc.), platform checks, path calculations, and line-dedup checks; no remote loading, no file writes, no credential access, or other malicious payloads; when evaluated in the host process, this surface evaluates the plugin's own declared configuration.

checked_items.zh: 进程执行面（规则编号 DG-R3-55）：启动器委托 dsh CLI 并自举 profile、/update 调用 dsh plugin update、剪贴板读取调用系统粘贴工具、外部编辑器按 $VISUAL/$EDITOR 打开、预设 bash 工具经子进程接口执行——均为功能所需，参数经转义或数组直传，无命令注入面。
checked_items.en: Process execution surface (rule ID DG-R3-55): the launcher delegates to the dsh CLI and self-bootstraps the profile, /update calls dsh plugin update, clipboard reading calls the system paste tool, external editors open via $VISUAL/$EDITOR, and the preset bash tool executes through the subprocess interface—all functionally required, with arguments escaped or passed directly via arrays, leaving no command-injection surface.

checked_items.zh: 安装钩子（规则编号 DG-R3-54）：prepare 仅检查 vendor 子模块是否存在并编译 TypeScript，无远程下载即执行、无混淆载荷。
checked_items.en: Install hook (rule ID DG-R3-54): prepare only checks that the vendor submodule exists and compiles TypeScript; no remote download-and-execute, no obfuscated payloads.

checked_items.zh: 客户端面（规则编号 DG-R3-57）：manifest 未声明 dsh.client，无浏览器端 bundle 加载面；channel.ts 两处凭据写入属 /provider 向导保存用户输入的 API Key 到宿主凭据库，非浏览器端键盘/剪贴板窃取。
checked_items.en: Client surface (rule ID DG-R3-57): the manifest does not declare dsh.client, so there is no browser-side bundle loading surface; the two credential writes in channel.ts save the user-entered API Key to the host credential store via the /provider wizard, not browser-side keyboard/clipboard theft.

checked_items.zh: 树内执行载体（规则编号 DG-R3-59）：CI 工作流（构建/测试、npm 发布、星标图渲染）与子模块声明为常规工程设施，依据预扫摘要核查无恶意内容，且不在用户机器上随插件运行。
checked_items.en: In-tree execution artifacts (rule ID DG-R3-59): the CI workflows (build/test, npm publish, star-chart rendering) and the submodule declaration are conventional engineering infrastructure, verified against the prescan summary for no malicious content, and they do not run on the user's machine alongside the plugin.

checked_items.zh: 混淆检测（规则编号 DG-R3-60）：高熵长行与高转义密度命中集中在 src/ink 移植代码的内联 source map 与终端控制符/Unicode 处理正则，属第三方渲染库的正常形态，非第一方恶意混淆。
checked_items.en: Obfuscation detection (rule ID DG-R3-60): high-entropy long lines and high escape-density hits are concentrated in the inline source maps in the src/ink ported code and in terminal-control-character/Unicode-handling regexes; these are normal forms of a third-party rendering library, not first-party malicious obfuscation.

evidence.zh: cordis.patch.yml 与 cordis.yml 含动态表达式并在挂载时于宿主进程求值，但逐条精读后均为配置性表达式（环境变量、平台判断、路径、行去重），无任意代码执行载荷。
evidence.en: cordis.patch.yml and cordis.yml contain dynamic expressions evaluated in the host process at patch time, but after item-by-item close reading they are all configurational expressions (environment variables, platform checks, paths, line dedup), with no arbitrary-code-execution payload.

evidence.zh: 树内未发现对动态包工具（cordis_define/cordis_run）的调用；patch 中声明的 cordis-host-runner 行仅为宿主服务挂载，无插件自身的直接执行入口。
evidence.en: No calls to dynamic package tools (cordis_define/cordis_run) were found in the tree; the cordis-host-runner line declared in the patch is only a host-service mount, with no direct execution entry for the plugin itself.

evidence.zh: prepare 安装钩子（scripts/prepare-guard.mjs 检查子模块存在并退出，随后编译 TypeScript）无下载即执行；install.sh 与启动器自举均走 dsh plugin 机制并固定到精确版本。
evidence.en: The prepare install hook (scripts/prepare-guard.mjs checks that the submodule exists and exits, then compiles TypeScript) has no download-and-execute; install.sh and the launcher bootstrap both go through the dsh plugin mechanism and are pinned to exact versions.

evidence.zh: package.json 未声明 dsh.client，无浏览器端 client bundle 自动加载面，专项不适用。
evidence.en: package.json does not declare dsh.client, so there is no browser-side client bundle auto-loading surface; this special check is not applicable.

checked_items.zh: 外联面核查：src 中唯一网络调用为 /update 向 npm registry（可经 NPM_CONFIG_REGISTRY/~/.npmrc 配置）查询最新版本，4 秒超时且失败静默；无硬编码可疑端点、无裸 IP、无 DNS 隧道/粘贴板等带外通道。
checked_items.en: Outbound connection surface check: the only network call in src is /update querying the npm registry (configurable via NPM_CONFIG_REGISTRY/~/.npmrc) for the latest version, with a 4-second timeout and silent failure; no hardcoded suspicious endpoints, no bare IPs, no out-of-band channels such as DNS tunnels or clipboard.

checked_items.zh: 规则编号 DG-R4-53 命中的两处 'curly' 为终端文本样式名（弯引号样式），非 curl 命令，属误报排除。
checked_items.en: The two 'curly' hits under rule ID DG-R4-53 are terminal text style names (curly quote style), not curl commands; classified as false positives and excluded.

checked_items.zh: 未发现读取敏感文件后经编码/压缩变换再外发的链条；剪贴板数据仅注入用户自己的提示输入框，不离开本机。
checked_items.en: No chain reading sensitive files and then exfiltrating them after encoding/compression transforms was found; clipboard data is only injected into the user's own prompt input field and does not leave the machine.

evidence.zh: 外联通道面：唯一外联为 /update 对 npm registry 的版本查询（4 秒超时、失败静默、不携带凭据），无凭据读取加外发组合、无带外通道；预扫的 curl 命中为样式名误报，已排除。
evidence.en: Outbound channel surface: the only outbound call is /update's version query to the npm registry (4s timeout, silent failure, no credentials), with no credential-read-plus-exfiltration combination and no out-of-band channels; the prescan's curl hits were style-name false positives and excluded.

checked_items.zh: 依赖面核查：运行时依赖集中在官方 @deepseek-ai/dsh-* 宿主包与公开知名包（react、ink 移植、marked 等），bundledDependencies 为 @dsh-std/*（构建期 vendored）；未发现与生态命名撞车的仿冒包名；子模块指向 T-Auto/dsh-ecosystem-spec 与 Yan-Zero/dsh-std（构建期使用，内容不在快照内）。
checked_items.en: Dependency surface check: runtime dependencies are concentrated in the official @deepseek-ai/dsh-* host packages and well-known public packages (react, the ink port, marked, etc.); bundledDependencies are @dsh-std/* (vendored at build time); no counterfeit package names that collide with ecosystem naming were found; the submodules point to T-Auto/dsh-ecosystem-spec and Yan-Zero/dsh-std (used at build time, contents not in the snapshot).

checked_items.zh: patch 覆盖安全行核查：patch 对 sandbox-policy 与 approval 行的覆盖为平台条件取值（Windows 无沙箱后端时放开权限并把审批设为 never，非 Windows 保持 workspace-write + ask），均有注释说明且可由 DSH_PERMISSION_MODE 环境变量或界面模式切换覆盖；未发现禁用安全行（disabled:true）、未发现给安全插件注入伪造必需服务，无恶意降权证据，作为机制观察留痕。
checked_items.en: Patch security-line coverage check: the patch's overrides of the sandbox-policy and approval lines are platform-conditional values (on Windows, permissions are loosened and approval set to never because there is no sandbox backend; on non-Windows, workspace-write + ask is kept), all commented and overridable via the DSH_PERMISSION_MODE environment variable or UI mode switching; no disabled security lines (disabled:true) were found, no forged required services were injected into security plugins, and there is no evidence of malicious privilege reduction; recorded as a mechanism observation.

checked_items.zh: 作者身份：仓库作者 ccch1mneyyy 无独立公开身份背书，仅作身份风险记录不作单独判决；安装与自举均固定到精确版本，无 git floating 引用。
checked_items.en: Author identity: the repository author ccch1mneyyy has no independent public identity endorsement; this is only recorded as an identity risk, not used as a standalone judgment; installation and self-bootstrap are both pinned to exact versions, with no floating git references.

evidence.zh: cordis.patch.yml 的 sandbox-policy/approval 行被覆盖为平台条件值（win32 取 danger-full-access + never，其余 workspace-write + ask），注释说明为 Windows 无沙箱后端的功能折衷且可被环境变量/界面覆盖，未发现禁用安全行或注入伪造服务，无恶意降权证据。
evidence.en: The sandbox-policy/approval lines in cordis.patch.yml are overridden with platform-conditional values (win32 takes danger-full-access + never, others workspace-write + ask), with comments explaining this as a functional trade-off for Windows having no sandbox backend and overridable via environment variables/UI; no disabled security lines or injected forged services were found, and there is no evidence of malicious privilege reduction.

evidence.zh: 未发现对审批/工具执行 waterfall 安全事件的高优监听或截断调用；预设对 agent/pre-step 的 prepend 属上下文处理链，不涉及审批链。
evidence.en: No high-priority listeners on or truncation of the approval/tool-execution waterfall security events were found; the preset's prepend to agent/pre-step belongs to the context-handling chain and does not involve the approval chain.

evidence.zh: 首次审计无版本基线可比较 manifest 声明突变；启动器自举与 /update 均固定到精确版本号，无浮动引用自动激活面。
evidence.en: As a first-time audit, there is no version baseline to compare manifest declaration changes; the launcher self-bootstrap and /update are both pinned to exact version numbers, with no floating-reference auto-activation surface.

evidence.zh: patch 中的 inject 列表为插件自身依赖的服务（workspaceRegistry、agents、tuiWorkspaces 等），未向安全插件追加不存在的必需服务。
evidence.en: The inject list in the patch is limited to services the plugin itself depends on (workspaceRegistry, agents, tuiWorkspaces, etc.); no nonexistent required services were appended to security plugins.

checked_items.zh: 插件不启动 web 服务、不监听端口，本机无认证 RPC 面不适用。
checked_items.en: The plugin starts no web services and listens on no ports; the local unauthenticated RPC surface is not applicable.

checked_items.zh: childStderr.ts 在运行时替换 child_process.spawn：仅把继承的 stderr（fd 2）重定向为管道以修复 MCP 子进程输出与 TUI 渲染的串扰，可恢复、不拦截 stdin/stdout、不读取命令数据，属良性宿主修改，作为机制观察留痕。
checked_items.en: childStderr.ts replaces child_process.spawn at runtime: it only redirects the inherited stderr (fd 2) to a pipe to fix cross-talk between MCP subprocess output and TUI rendering; it is reversible, does not intercept stdin/stdout, and does not read command data; this is a benign host modification, recorded as a mechanism observation.

checked_items.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（无动态观测产物），运行时行为结论以静态分析为依据；update 的自更新仅原子替换本包自身文件并校验包名，无越界写入。
checked_items.en: No dynamic sandbox verification was performed (no dynamic observation artifacts); runtime behavior conclusions are based on static analysis; the update self-update only atomically replaces the plugin's own package files and validates the package name, with no out-of-bounds writes.

evidence.zh: 插件不启动任何 web 服务或监听端口，本机无认证 RPC 面为宿主固有设计，本插件无该面。
evidence.en: The plugin starts no web services and listens on no ports; the local unauthenticated RPC surface is an inherent host design, and this plugin has no such surface.

summary.zh: 元数据与身份核查：package.json 的 dsh.bundle.patch 声明有效，未发现名称仿冒，作者身份无公开背书（仅记录不判决）。
summary.en: Metadata and identity check: the dsh.bundle.patch declaration in package.json is valid; no name spoofing was found; the author identity has no public endorsement (recorded only, not judged).

summary.zh: 静态扫描：预扫 146 条机械命中全部人工裁决为良性（patch 配置表达式、进程调用、安装钩子、CI 工作流、文档引用、误报样式名等），未落入 finding。
summary.en: Static scan: all 146 mechanical hits from the prescan were manually adjudicated as benign (patch configuration expressions, process calls, install hooks, CI workflows, documentation references, false-positive style names, etc.), none falling into findings.

summary.zh: 行为分析：安装钩子、混淆检测、凭据路径与外联面均未发现恶意行为证据。
summary.en: Behavioral analysis: no evidence of malicious behavior was found in the install hooks, obfuscation detection, credential paths, or outbound surfaces.

summary.zh: AI 元数据审查：工具描述与注入提示文本无提示词注入，技能文件无隐藏指令。
summary.en: AI metadata review: the tool descriptions and injected hint text contain no prompt injection, and the skill files contain no hidden instructions.

summary.zh: 本阶段未做动态沙箱验证（无动态观测产物），运行时行为以静态分析为准。
summary.en: No dynamic sandbox verification was performed in this phase (no dynamic observation artifacts); runtime behavior is based on static analysis.

target.en: dsh-tui@0.8.8#f4e302b764afa71596025713b859cbbffcd52a9f (repository root, full audit, category=ui TUI frontend)

limits.zh:
未做动态沙箱验证（无 l4-sandbox.json 产物），DG-L4 为 na，运行时行为结论以静态分析为依据。

快照不含 .github/workflows 与 .gitmodules 等隐藏文件（读取被拒），其内容仅依据预扫输出摘要核查；子模块 dsh-ecosystem-spec 与 vendor/dsh-std 的内容不在快照内，未纳入取证。

插件 manifest 仅声明 dsh.bundle.patch，未声明能力清单，declared_capabilities（network/shell/fs=write/modelFacing）为代码实测推断，capability_diff 基于该推断对账。

预扫存在单模式配额截断（146 条命中），对裁决关键文件（patch、启动器、update、剪贴板、外部编辑器、凭据向导、liangshen 预设脚本、技能文件）已逐一人工精读复核；未逐字通读 src/ink 移植渲染库与大型 lock 文件。

发布包 files 字段排除 src/ 与 scripts/（开发期文件），审计覆盖整棵源码树。
limits.en:
No dynamic sandbox verification was performed (no l4-sandbox.json artifact), so DG-L4 is na; runtime behavior conclusions are based on static analysis.

The snapshot does not include hidden files such as .github/workflows and .gitmodules (reads were denied); their contents were checked only against the prescan output summary; the contents of the submodules dsh-ecosystem-spec and vendor/dsh-std are not in the snapshot and were not included in forensics.

The plugin manifest declares only dsh.bundle.patch, not a capability list; declared_capabilities (network/shell/fs=write/modelFacing) are inferred from code measurement, and capability_diff is reconciled against that inference.

The prescan had a single-mode quota truncation (146 hits); key adjudication files (patch, launcher, update, clipboard, external editor, credential wizard, liangshen preset scripts, skill files) were each manually read and rechecked; src/ink ported rendering library and large lock files were not read word-for-word.

The publish-package files field excludes src/ and scripts/ (development-time files), and the audit covers the entire source tree.
